title: Phenomenal properties are causally potent as intentional objects

statements.text: Phenomenal properties exist as intentional objects, a sort of mental fiction, and move people the way ideas, stories and theories do, by figuring as the objects of intentional states. This lets illusionism acknowledge both how magical they seem and how powerfully they affect people.
